name: Crown Ward
controller: Crown Magistracy and old noble houses
look: Marble galleries, a citadel of black steel and white stone, clock towers on every square, gas lamps with brass cages, named streets, private gardens under glass domes.
monsters: Mimics and doubles, creatures living in mirrors and portraits, mind control. Nobles secretly dabble in black magic.
rumor_tags: a servant 'acting differently'; mirrors covered with cloth; one more guest at the ball than invited
role: Expensive secret contracts with strict deadlines; failure hurts reputation.
mood: polished, cold, silent luxury hiding rot

name: Silverhill
size: Large (north-north-west, from the centre to the wall)
danger: A by day, P by night
look: White cathedrals with moon-shaped rose windows, silver domes, convent walls, terraced cemetery down to the Ringwall, orphanage courtyards.
landmarks: 4 — Cathedral of the Pale Vault; 5 — Convent of St. Aldric
monsters: Sleepwalkers, 'Moon children', silver parasites, moth swarms. Hidden truth: the moon they worship is the Masked Moon, a creature wearing a god's skin.
rumor_tags: at full moon; smells of incense and blood; the victim was smiling
role: Long story chain of Chapter I; healing and holy consumables.

name: Vigil Spire Ward
look: A 300-metre honeycomb tower with 49 elevators, barracks, drill yards, archive halls, steel banners.
monsters: Rare: escaped evidence from archives, possessed knights.
rumor_tags: armour found empty; orders given by no one; lights in the archive at night
role: Dossiers on monsters (contract tags revealed early), knight armor blueprints.

name: Lumen Campus
look: Lecture halls, glass laboratories, chimneys with coloured smoke, the Great Library with a brass dome, mechanical department workshops.
landmarks: 3 — Great Library of the Collegium (the hero's Library action)
monsters: Escaped 'Clay Saints' (artificial humans), victims of transmutation, living formulas.
rumor_tags: smell of formalin; glass chiming; the skull opened neatly, like in a lecture
role: Library actions; buyer of captured creatures; Mechanic blueprints.
mood: clinical, curious, brass and glass, knowledge as power

name: Rowan Market
look: Covered rows, scales, crates, awnings, a central hall with a rowan tree carved in wood. The hero's shop is a wooden table with cards.
monsters: Smuggled 'sleeping' creatures in crates, wood parasites, a curse of greed (cursed object).
rumor_tags: the cargo moved; a trader went mad with greed; roots through the cobbles
mood: busy, warm lamplight, haggling, hidden contraband

name: Rowan Exchange Posts
size: Three small enclaves at the gates
controller: Rowan Exchange houses: Harrow (Hawk), Varga (Wolf), Brannoc (Bear)
look: Fortified warehouses at the gates, totem carvings (eagle / wolf / bear), caravan yards, weighing towers.
landmarks: 14 — Hawk Gate post; 15 — Wolf Gate post; 16 — Bear Gate post
monsters: Things that come in from the Mistveil with caravans.
rumor_tags: fog on the cargo; a caravan arrived with one driver too many
role: House-specific shop lines (Hawk = scopes, Bear = armor, Wolf = hunting mechanisms).
mood: fortified, tribal-mercantile, fog at the gates

name: The Numbered Avenues
size: Very large (west and south-west, from inner ring to the wall)
controller: Nobody (formally the Magistracy, in practice the Iron Vigil)
look: An endless grid of identical streets: '12th Avenue', 'Street K'. Offices, shops, tenement houses, trams.
landmarks: 13 — the quiet bookshop on 23rd Avenue (easter egg: its rumor can never be investigated — 'Contact not advised')
monsters: Everyday horror: something in the drains, in the neighbours' cellar, on the last tram.
rumor_tags: wet handprints on windows; children singing in the drains; the last tram arrived empty
role: Most generated side contracts; good place to farm rumors.
mood: grey routine, rain, repetition, lonely windows

name: Morrell Ward
look: Clinics, apothecaries, greenhouses with herbs, a morgue with green lamps.
landmarks: 10 — Morrell Apothecarium & clinic (Hunter's Fall wake-up point)
monsters: Patients who did not die, disease-beings, infections from the Lower City.
rumor_tags: the corpse was warm a week later; bitter herbal smell; nurses refuse the night shift
role: Treatment of HP and the Voice; tonics; buys captured creatures.
mood: sterile green light, herbs, quiet suffering

name: Nordhal Quarter
controller: Hunter crews and the old Nordhal families
look: Dark brick, Nordhal runes on doors, forges, fighting pits, steam from bathhouses.
landmarks: 7 — Tavern 'The Lantern & Hook' (contract board); 8 — the hero's workshop-home
monsters: Infected hunters turning into beasts — a familiar face from the tavern can become a contract.
rumor_tags: a howl; human footprints turning into paws; smell of blood and medicine
role: Hub: tavern, workshop, home. Blood formulas from the Pale Hounds or the Weavers.
mood: rough, warm firelight, brotherhood and dread

name: Grey Chapels
controller: Nobody officially; the Grey Communion secretly
look: Ruined chapels of a forgotten faith, shanty roofs, grey fog in cellars, bonfires.
monsters: Fog corruption, cult summonings, rat swarms.
rumor_tags: grey fog in the cellar; prayers to the god in the wall; people with grey eyes
role: Contact with the Grey Communion; ichor; secret path down in Chapter II.
mood: poverty, ash and fog, forbidden faith

name: Deepwright Lifts
look: Giant mine lifts going down through the platform, foundries, ore yards, machines roaring, workers in masks.
landmarks: 9 — Deepwright Main Lifts (descent to the Lower City)
monsters: Burrow Wyrm (rank D: digs, chitin shell, acid), creatures riding up the lifts.
rumor_tags: walls eaten through; the floor collapsed; workers heard knocking from below
role: Best district for Gears/Scrap; the way down in Chapter II.
mood: industrial hell, sparks, steam, deep shafts

name: Scarlet Lantern Row
look: Narrow alleys under red lanterns, brothels, gambling dens, underground auction houses, black magicians' parlours.
monsters: Illusions, blood curses, creatures summoned by clients.
rumor_tags: a client left without a face; whispering in an unknown tongue; blood on the mirror
mood: red light, perfume and blood, seductive danger
